positioning: Build real projects with your teammates and AI. Learn real skills.
manifesto1: Intelligence widens what collaboration can be.
manifesto2: A team now holds people and AI, and AI can divide work among itself.
manifesto3: Cheese is built for this: between people, between people and AI, and between AI and AI.
memoryTitle: It remembers for as long as the project runs
memoryBody: The AI teammate is there from the first day and knows every discussion, decision and document. Come back after a week and ask where things stand.
agentsBody: Faced with a complex task, the AI teammate breaks it down and sends several agents to work in parallel: research, code, reports, each on its own part.
previewBody: Web pages, slides and results the agents produce open right inside the project, with nothing to deploy.
reviewBody: Submitted work waits for review. Accepted work joins the project; returned work goes back for changes. Every decision leaves a record.
modelsBody: Use the models the platform provides, chosen per task
cloudBody: Code and prototypes run on a cloud work computer as they are written
deviceBody: Connect your computer and let AI work in the folders you allow
resourceTerms: Free trial credit is included. Universities and companies can add models and cloud resources as needed.
peopleLead: Companies post real problems, teachers bring them into class, students take them on in teams, and AI helps throughout.
studentsBody: Work through real problems with an AI teammate. The process and results are kept in full, as a record of what you have done.
studentsStep2: Form a team and work with AI
teachersBody: Publish weekly units and assignments. Each group's discussions, decisions and results stay in the project, so guidance rests on what actually happened.
teachersStep1: Bring in problems and publish units
teachersStep2: Join each group's project as a mentor
companiesBody: Post a business problem and get solutions back, along with the people who built them.
companiesStep2: Students and faculty take it on
companiesStep3: Meet the talent and keep working together
outputs: When a project ends, its process and results can become research reports, case studies and course material for the next cohort.
visionBody: Cheese connects students, teachers and companies through real projects. Every project keeps its discussions, judgments and results, so the next cohort or the next team can pick up where it left off.
policyLink: Read the AI + Education Action Plan

room.askProgress: I was away this week. What changed? Did we settle the evaluation criteria?
room.answerProgress: Yes, the three Ms. Li set on September 18. The prototype follows them, and a first version can be ready this week.
room.askPrototype: Can we have a first version of the prototype this week?
room.splitWork: Yes. I'll split it into three parallel tasks: research, build the prototype, and make the evaluation slides.
room.triedIt: Tried a few questions in the preview. Every source opens.
room.previewAnswer: Read the project overview, then the decisions and next steps from the latest discussion.
room.reviewState: Waiting for Ms. Li to review
room.setCriteria: Let's settle the evaluation criteria: answers cite their sources, cover at least 80% of common newcomer questions, and respond within two seconds.
room.noted: Added to section 2 of the evaluation plan.

solutions.title: Fit for purpose
solutions.lead: Universities, companies and research teams each take what they need, with services and resources enabled on demand.

university.label: Universities and institutions
university.title: Take the classroom into real projects
university.body: For schools, colleges and innovation centers that run practice projects as courses. Teachers plan week by week, students work in teams, AI takes part throughout, and the process and results are kept in full.
university.step1: Open a course and bring in problems
university.step2: Students form teams and work with AI
university.step3: Review results and keep them as teaching material

company.label: Companies
company.title: You set the problem, students and faculty solve it
company.body: Post real business problems as topics. University students and faculty take them on in teams, with AI throughout. The results come back to you for review, and partnerships and hires grow from there.
company.step2: Students and faculty team up with AI

research.label: Research teams
research.title: Keep the story of your research traceable
research.body: Topic discussions, literature, code experiments and writing live in one project. People come and go; the work keeps building.

solutionsPage.title: Solutions
solutionsPage.heroBody: Grow people through real projects: for schools, companies and research teams, members build real projects with AI, the process stays visible, and what they learn stays behind.
solutionsPage.growthLead: How members think and decide stays in the project, so guidance rests on what actually happened.
solutionsPage.traceBody: Discussions, decisions and results stay in the project. Members come and go; the work keeps building.
solutionsPage.reviewBody: Results from AI go to a person for review. Accepted work joins the project; sent-back work gets revised.
solutionsPage.unitsBody: In a course, publish content and assignments unit by unit, and each group completes them in its own project.
solutionsPage.trustLead: Data stays in mainland China, and deployment and access follow what your organisation needs.
solutionsPage.residencyBody: Data is stored in mainland China and does not leave it.
solutionsPage.deployBody: Cheese can be deployed on your organisation's own servers.
solutionsPage.teamsBody: Projects belong to teams, and team leads manage members, resources and quota.
solutionsPage.ctaTitle: Grow people through real projects, together
solutionsPage.ctaBody: Write to ops{'@'}okcheese.com and tell us about your setting.

visionLead: Learn on real problems. Grow by working together.
ctaTitle: Many minds, one work. Start with a project.
ctaBody: Bring a real problem, and get it done with your team and AI.
visionPolicy: In April 2026, China's Ministry of Education and four other departments issued the AI + Education Action Plan. It calls for future learning centers, project-based, inquiry-based and scenario-based learning, and new ways of teaching in which people and AI work together.
